about_the_game:
Just as Faye and Rich’s painful memories resurface, the two friends are ensnared in the distorted corridors of a decrepit subway station beneath a city still foreign to Faye. To find any path through, they need to decipher all that they have so desperately tried to forget.

Illustration and Reflection

Discover and illustrate meaningful objects and people to decipher Faye’s history.

Living Memories

Explore living memories of Faye and Rich’s past as they manifest around the stations.

Choice and Change

Forge a new relationship between Faye and Rich as they collide with their hidden traumas and recent frictions.

Dissipation of Agency

Navigate Faye’s anxieties as distance between her and Rich propagates greater dangers around the station.

Close-up Clues

Interact with objects and structures more intimately to decipher their connection to Faye’s past, or the distortion of the station.

Clarity and Discovery

Strip away the distortion of the subway by listening to Faye’s music. With newfound clarity, spot clues and untangle her muddled past.  

Face the past—it’s the only way forward.

content_descriptors.notes: Stuck in the Present contains mature content including realistic violence involving the use of poison and drowning. The game addresses complex mental health themes such as anxiety, and panic attacks. This content may not be suitable for all audiences.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 4th generation Intel Core processor or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Stuck in the Present is a 3D side-scrolling psychological horror title where two friends relive painful memories within the uncanny depths of twisting subway stations in a large, unfamiliar city.
